findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/components/Common/FeatureListDataGrid/FeatureListDataGrid.test.tsx:688 (spy on HTMLElement.prototype.getBoundingClientRect in scrolls a focused cell clear of the pinned move menu)
findings.obligation: Test hygiene: a test resets what it changes (test-writing rule 7); P12 falsifier is unaffected
findings.observation: The spy is never restored. vitest.config.ts sets no restoreMocks, and the describe afterEach (line 594) restores only statedCut spies and the window, so the prototype mock stays installed for the tooltip tests that follow in the file. They pass today, but their geometry depends on run order.
findings.remediation: Restore the spy at the end of the test (try/finally or a handle restored in afterEach), so no later test sees it. Non-blocking for the RED.

findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/components/Common/FeatureListDataGrid/FeatureListDataGrid.test.tsx:681 (scrolls a focused cell clear of the pinned move menu, the right-edge assertion)
findings.obligation: P12 falsifier: a focused cell must end before the pinned actions column; and the check must still hold when the pinned column is over-scrolled
findings.observation: The only assertion is state right <= 300. The mock gives the State cell left = 200 - scrolled, so a scroll of 1000 px (left -800, cell wholly before the table start) passes. The before-start branch of scrollCellClearOfPinned is not claimed by this check.
findings.remediation: Add a visibility bound: after the focus, the State cell left is at least the scroller left (0) and right is at most 300. Non-blocking for the RED.
